description.value: Lot 1 Pasta Bar is Victoria's original pasta bar, blending family-heritage Italian recipes with international flavours and locally sourced BC ingredients in a warehouse-style space with 17-foot ceilings and an industrial aesthetic. Founded by the team behind Victoria's original burger lounge, it offers handcrafted pasta, creative cocktails featuring local distilleries, and a rotating selection of Vancouver Island draught beers. A touring cyclist looking for a substantial sit-down meal with gluten-free and vegan options in the heart of Victoria would find this a solid choice.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business is an active dine-in/takeout fusion pasta restaurant at 204 - 815 Cloverdale Ave, Victoria BC. The website explicitly mentions gluten-free options, a vegan dessert, and takeout/delivery ordering, but contains no mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities. OSM only supplies a unit number and cuisine tag; the full address and phone come entirely from the website.
concerns: OSM record is missing phone and full address; both sourced entirely from website.
No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) mentioned anywhere on the website — all required criteria are unverifiable without a site visit.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is clearly active and a viable cyclist dining stop, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website. On-site verification is needed before listing.
